text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "formulations such as ‘the president is paying a state visit to’ or ‘is currently on a state visit abroad’ are incorrect from a Swiss perspective", "gist": "Swiss perspective considers those phrases incorrect"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "it is more accurate to speak of a ‘presidential visit’", "gist": "Swiss prefers 'presidential visit' over 'state visit' for their president"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "no one individual is considered to be head of state in Switzerland", "gist": "Switzerland does not have a single head of state"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "the President of the Swiss Confederation should be accorded the same standing as his or her foreign counterparts when they meet", "gist": "Swiss President should receive same protocol treatment as foreign heads of state during meetings"}]}
